text: Labneh is yoghurt that has been salted and then drained of whey in cloth, which concentrates the protein into a thick, tangy spread. Codex lists it as a concentrated fermented milk, with at least 5.6 % protein.

links.name: Codex Standard for Fermented Milks CXS 243-2003

steps.note: Salt is added, which helps it keep.
The yoghurt is drained of its whey, which concentrates its protein.
